description: This is a C++ test source file that tests the functionality of the TextFragment and TextSegmentIterator classes, which are likely part of the core library of the project. It includes unit tests verifying string segmenting, comparison, trimming, and iteration behaviors.

classes.name: TextFragment
classes.description: A class representing a segment or fragment of text, supporting operations like comparison, trimming, searching, and iteration.

classes.name: TextSegmentIterator
classes.description: An iterator class for traversing segments of text within a TextFragment based on delimiters or positions.
